page.notes: The symbol before "Sextum Præceptum" is a decorative initial mark, not a letter; it is left out. The "Eccl[?]siastico" word has an uncertain letter. The word "instituti" in the line "Quæ causæ instituti coniugii" is read as printed. The large "FIN" at the bottom is the start of FINIS and is kept as a fragment. Part heading "Quinta" printed as "Quint?" with an unclear ligature; read as Quinta [?]. Page number "x" beside the running head is uncertain. Long s is printed as f throughout and is transcribed as s. Entries "Quis Rex", "Cur bona corporalia", "Quarta", and the bare numbers 839, 847 and 841 are set on separate lines as printed. Small dashes and a mark in the left margin are not transcribed.
